pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Brown polygonal patches with rounded vertices and smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is largest on the mid-flank and decreases in spatial area towards the posterior and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light negative space forms a continuous lattice with junction nodes connecting three or four patches. Pathways exhibit variable pixel thickness, narrowing significantly at vertex points between larger patches.
